import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced with the # sanitized headline and content respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_blog_entry(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog entry for safe HTML display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. content : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML-formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on the webpage. Notes ----- * All user-supplied data is escaped using `html.escape` to prevent injection of malicious markup. * The function does not allow raw HTML in the content; if rich formatting is required, a proper sanitizer such as `bleach` should be used instead. """ if not isinstance(headline, str) or not isinstance(content, str): raise TypeError("headline and content must be strings") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent XSS. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) # For the content we escape as well; if you want to allow # a subset of tags, replace this with a proper sanitizer. safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Construct the final HTML using the predefined format. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content)
